subject: general
question: Who among the following is an award-winning folk Dancer from Arunachal Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sang Jangmu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sang Jangmu:-**

 
 
• She is an award-winning folk dancer from Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• She has won several awards and accolades for her performances in various folk dance competitions.
 
• She is known for her graceful and energetic performances that showcase the rich cultural heritage of Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• Sang Jangmu has also performed at various national and international events, promoting the culture and tradition of her state.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Meena Nayak:-**

 
 
• She is a famous Odissi dancer from Odisha.
 
 
 
• **Balkar Sidhu:-**
 
 
• She is a Punjabi singer and actor.
 
 
 
• **Tarubala Debbarma:-**
 
 
• She is a renowned folk dancer from Tripura.
